Eh. I don't think the combination of seriousness and spc absurdity really works that well. While I do think absurd humour and more serious stories can be mixed, it's a tricky thing to do, and I don't think this is the most successful combination.

The tone is all over the place, and the tale doesn't do anything all that new aside from the core concept. The basic premise of a dark and serious SPC story is one I think very few writers can pull of.

item.title: A Necromantic Prelude
item.content:encoded:
A Necromantic Prelude
Author: Lt Flops

This is a boldpost. Thank you to Almarduk for reading this over.

For a long while, I've wanted to write a series set in the Shark Punching Centre universe. This is the first entry in that series!

This isn't the SPC you or I know. I wanted to write a darker SPC universe without sacrificing the absurdity. I'm sure the characters of that 'verse are well sick and tired of being everyone's punching bag, and forever rue the day their lives became a long-running practical joke spawned from a clerical error. With that in mind, it's about to get much worse for them.

Please note: This article does not primarily feature the Shark Punching Centre. It is set in their universe and they are name-dropped, but don't expect them to show up consistently in future instalments. With an entire alternate universe to play in, someone else needs the spotlight!

In any case, happy Halloween and please enjoy this short prelude of things to come!

ETA: So this was originally a part of my NaNoWriMo project of 2019. I never actually finished the storyline, but I don't want to do away with this Tale. It's still a fun little thing, to me, and it's going to stay around in case myself or any other writer wishes to come back to this and write in this setting in the future.

If you liked this, check out my Author Page!
